text.en: A letter for the champion. Best read it somewhere with plenty of light.
text.zh-CN: 给老勇士的信。最好找个明亮的地方看。

text.en: Stay a moment. A challenge deserves an answer.
text.zh-CN: 稍等。有人下战书，总得回个话。

text.en: Ah! The paper—my eyes!
text.zh-CN: 啊！这纸……我的眼睛！

text.en: Poison on a letter? Couldn't you just lose an argument like everyone else?
text.zh-CN: 在信上涂毒？就不能像别人那样，辩不过就认输吗？

text.en: He can't see. Move in!
text.zh-CN: 他看不见了，动手！

text.en: You'll have to get through us first.
text.zh-CN: 先过我们这一关。

text.en: Well. That's one way to make me stop reading.
text.zh-CN: 好吧，想让我不看书，也不必用这种办法。

text.en: Sit down. Don't rub your eyes.
text.zh-CN: 先坐下，别揉眼睛。

text.en: The paper was poisoned. Gerda keeps a healer's garden near Rainmarket. She may know an antidote.
text.zh-CN: 纸上有毒。格尔达在雨集镇附近照料一座药草花园，她也许知道解药。

text.en: Then we'll find her. How do we reach the garden?
text.zh-CN: 我们去找她。花园怎么走？

text.en: Take the woodland trail outside Rainmarket. Follow the herbs. Avoid the invitations.
text.zh-CN: 走雨集镇外的林间小径，顺着药草香找。至于邀请函，就别碰了。

text.en: Rest here. We'll bring back help—and less mail.
text.zh-CN: 在这里休息吧。我们会带回帮手，少带几封信。

text.en: We're on our way to Gerda. Try to rest.
text.zh-CN: 我们正要去找格尔达，先好好休息。

text.en: I will. No reading until further notice.
text.zh-CN: 好。另行通知前，我绝不看信。

text.en: Gerda? Please tell me you're in. We need help.
text.zh-CN: 格尔达？但愿你在家，我们需要帮忙。

text.en: Kai? What happened?
text.zh-CN: 凯？出什么事了？

text.en: A poisoned letter. The champion at Winter Cottage can barely see.
text.zh-CN: 一封毒信。冬日小屋的老勇士几乎看不见了。

text.en: For this poison, I need a Nightshade Blossom to prepare the antidote. The apothecary may know where to find one.
text.zh-CN: 要配这种毒的解药，需要一株夜影花。那位药师也许知道哪里能找到。

text.en: Will you come with us?
text.zh-CN: 你愿意和我们一起去吗？

text.en: Of course. And Kai—this time, let me handle anything that stings, burns, or glows.
text.zh-CN: 当然。还有，凯——这回那些扎手、灼人或发光的东西，让我来碰。

苗人凤眼睛被奸人毒瞎，需请求毒手药王医治.en: The champion at Winter Cottage was blinded by a poisoned letter. Find Gerda at the Healer's Garden near Rainmarket.
苗人凤眼睛被奸人毒瞎，需请求毒手药王医治.zh-CN: 冬日小屋的老勇士被毒信伤了眼睛，需要去雨集镇附近的药草花园找格尔达。

程灵素答应医治金面佛苗人凤的眼睛.en: Gerda joined to help the poisoned champion. We still need a Nightshade Blossom for the antidote.
程灵素答应医治金面佛苗人凤的眼睛.zh-CN: 格尔达加入队伍，帮助中毒的老勇士；配解药仍需要夜影花。

description.en: Your poison effects are 5 levels stronger and last 4 extra turns.
description.zh-CN: 你施加的中毒效果提高5级，持续时间延长4回合。

description.en: In battle, ignores item cooldowns. Using an item still ends this character's action.
description.zh-CN: 战斗中可忽略物品冷却；用药仍会结束当前角色的行动。

description.en: Your attacks do not cause friendly-fire damage.
description.zh-CN: 你的攻击不会对队友造成误伤伤害。

description.en: Herbs fill the quiet garden. Gerda tends the beds and helps travelers in need.
description.zh-CN: 药草长满安静的花园，格尔达在这里照料花圃，帮助有需要的旅人。

description.en: A wooded trail beyond Rainmarket. Check Goals for the marked path; an encounter may interrupt the walk.
description.zh-CN: 雨集镇外的林间小径。可从目标查看指引，途中可能遇到伏击。

description.en: The trail continues deeper into the woods.
description.zh-CN: 小径继续通往林中深处。

description.en: Water and birdsong carry through the trees.
An unfamiliar herbal scent drifts along one of the paths.
description.zh-CN: 一条小径上飘来陌生的药草香。

description.en: Old trees shelter another quiet crossing.
description.zh-CN: 古树遮住另一处安静的路口。

有人正在送信给金面佛苗人凤.en: A courier is delivering a letter to the old champion.

被毒瞎眼睛的金面佛苗人凤.en: The poisoned champion is waiting for an antidote.
被毒瞎眼睛的金面佛苗人凤.zh-CN: 中毒的老勇士正等着解药。

通往衡阳郊外…….en: A path toward the outskirts of Rainmarket.
通往衡阳郊外…….zh-CN: 通往雨集镇郊外的小径。

通往古林深处…….en: The trail leads deeper into the woods.

前方人声鼎沸…….en: Voices carry from beyond the trees.

传来哗啦啦的水流声…….en: Running water can be heard beyond the trees.

传来一阵阵阴风…….en: A chill draft comes from the cave.

传来阵阵奇怪的花香…….en: An unfamiliar floral scent drifts down the trail.
传来阵阵奇怪的花香…….zh-CN: 小径上飘来陌生的花香。
